summary: Phase 14 SEO Autopilot READ_ONLY mode testing completed successfully. All backend APIs, frontend UI, and zero-mutation guarantees verified. Engine correctly operates in READ_ONLY mode with FULL locked, GSC connected (0 impressions expected), and all public resources unchanged after analysis runs.
